info.title: Voholabs Studio Public API
info.description:
Schedule posts, manage media, read analytics, the agent brief, the skills library and the credit wallet of a Voholabs Studio workspace.

Authenticate with the workspace's API key (Settings, Public API) or an OAuth token (`pos_...`) in the `Authorization` header, without a `Bearer` prefix.

Errors: a refusal that needs wallet credits answers 402 with `{ message, wallet: true, url: "/wallet" }`; `url` is relative to the Studio app. Other refusals carry `msg` or `message`.

get.description: Answers when the key or OAuth token is valid.
The connected channels (called integrations in the API). TikTok and every other channel are available on all plans; X is charged per post from the wallet on pay-as-you-go workspaces.

get.description: Groups (customers) used to label channels.

get.summary: Get a channel's posting rules and settings
get.description: The rules, maximum length, settings schema and tools of a channel's provider. Pass the settings it describes as `settings` when creating a post.

settings.description: A JSON schema of the settings, or the string "No additional settings required"

post.description: Runs one of the tools a channel's provider exposes (listed by GET /integration-settings/{id}), e.g. looking up a Discord channel list.

get.summary: Get a connect URL for a channel
get.description: Starts connecting a new channel: returns the provider's OAuth URL to open in a browser. `integration` is a provider identifier such as `linkedin`, `tiktok` or `x`. A provider the workspace cannot use yet answers 402: for X on a free workspace the body carries `wallet: true` and the top-up link.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Id of an existing channel to reconnect

delete.description: Disconnects a channel and deletes the posts scheduled on it.

get.description: The next free time slot on a channel's posting schedule.
Posts in a date range.

parameters.name: customer
parameters.description: Only the channels of this group (customer) id

post.description:
Creates one post per entry of `posts` (each on one channel; `value` is the post then its thread items or comments). `type` is `draft`, `schedule` or `now`.

Wallet: on a pay-as-you-go workspace, a post on a channel charged per post (see GET /wallet/prices) is paid from the wallet credits when it is scheduled, each thread item separately; drafts are free until scheduled. Editing re-prices only what changed; deleting, moving back to draft or a failed send gives the credits back. When the credits (with auto top-up) do not cover it, nothing is saved and the answer is 402 with `wallet: true`. Price a post first with POST /wallet/estimate.

delete.description: Deletes the post's whole group (the post, its thread items and comments). A published post is only removed from the calendar unless `deleteFromPlatform=true`, which also deletes it on networks that support that. Credits paid for parts not sent yet are given back.

parameters.name: deleteFromPlatform
parameters.description: Also delete the published message on the network

delete.description: Same as DELETE /posts/{id}, by group id.

parameters.name: deleteFromPlatform
parameters.description: Also delete the published message on the network

put.summary: Move a post between draft and the schedule
put.description: `schedule` puts a draft back on the schedule at its time (and pays for it from the wallet on a pay-as-you-go workspace, 402 when the credits do not cover it); `draft` takes it off and gives its credits back.

put.summary: Link a post to its message on the network
put.description: Sets the network's id for a published post whose link was lost, so its analytics can be read.

get.summary: List candidate messages for a post that lost its link
get.description: Recent messages on the network that may be this post, to pick a release id from.

post.description: Multipart upload (field `file`) into the media library: jpeg, png, gif, webp, avif, bmp, tiff or mp4. On the free plan a full library answers 413. On a pay-as-you-go workspace storage above the free amount is paid when the file is uploaded; 402 when the credits do not cover it.

post.summary: Upload a file from a URL
post.description: Fetches a public https URL into the media library. Same limits and storage rules as POST /upload.

Returns a URL that accepts one multipart upload without the API key, valid for a few minutes. `purpose: "brief"` mints a link for the brief upload route, which also accepts documents (PDF and the like) for the brief's Branding & assets.

purpose.description: Anything other than "brief" is a media ticket

post.description: The `uploadUrl` from POST /upload-ticket. The ticket in the path is the credential; send no API key. Same storage rules as POST /upload.

post.summary: Upload a brief file with a ticket
post.description: The `uploadUrl` from POST /upload-ticket with `purpose: "brief"`. Takes images and documents; stored in the media library and counted as storage. Register it on a brief document's `assets` with PATCH /brief/{category}/{key}.

get.description: 18 items a page, newest first.

delete.description: Removes a file from the library. Storage already paid for is not given back.

get.description: What the network reports about a channel over the last `date` days; each network has its own metrics. Answers come from a one-hour cache; the `X-Cached-At` header says when they were read from the network. `fresh=true` reads the network again (ignored on a paid plan; on a pay-as-you-go workspace X reads are charged, 402 when the credits do not cover them).

X-Cached-At.description: When the numbers were read from the network (ISO time)

get.description: What the network reports for one published post, read live. `{ missing: true }` means the post is not linked to its message on the network (see PUT /posts/{id}/release-id).
The workspace's notifications, newest first.

The workspace's wallet credits: balance, pay-as-you-go state, auto top-up and the forecast of paid usage still to come in the next hours (next occurrences of repeating posts, and posts queued before charging moved to scheduling time). Read-only: top-ups happen in the app at `topUpUrl`. A paid plan answers `{ usesWallet: false }`.
Everything that costs credits or opens with the first top-up, grouped into sections. Prices change; read them here rather than hard-coding them. Channels not listed are free.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Only this provider's rows, e.g. x

get.description: Top-ups, charges, refunds, grants and adjustments, newest first. `credits` is signed: positive adds to the balance, negative spends.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Entry types, comma separated, of TOPUP, AUTO_TOPUP, SPEND, REFUND, GRANT, ADJUST

post.description: What a post and its thread items on one provider would take from the wallet if scheduled now, priced with the rule that charges them. Nothing is charged. With `group` (a post being edited) what it already paid counts towards the new price; with `inter` (repeat every n days) the price is per occurrence.

contents.description: The post, then each thread item, as it will be saved

get.description: The skills library: step-by-step methods for content jobs, as a short catalog. Opens with the first wallet top-up (402 with `wallet: true` before that); paid plans always pass.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only skills with this tag key

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Words in the name, summary or tags

get.description: One skill in full, with its instructions.
The categories and documents of the agent brief and what may be created or deleted in each. Open on a paid plan or after the first wallet top-up; 402 with `wallet: true` otherwise.
Every document in the agent brief. Open on a paid plan or after the first wallet top-up; 402 with `wallet: true` otherwise.

Whether the guided brief onboarding is available, running or has run, and whether starting a new run takes credits. The onboarding is an interview the user takes in the app, so it is started at `startUrl`, not through the API. Open on a paid plan or after the first wallet top-up; 402 with `wallet: true` otherwise.
One document. Open on a paid plan or after the first wallet top-up; 402 with `wallet: true` otherwise.

patch.description: Saves a document. A field left out keeps what is stored; `blocks`, `links` and `assets` are each replaced whole, so send the existing items with your changes. Open on a paid plan or after the first wallet top-up; 402 with `wallet: true` otherwise.

delete.description: Deletes a document in a category that allows it. By default its history goes with it; `keepHistory=true` keeps the revisions and records the removal. Open on a paid plan or after the first wallet top-up; 402 with `wallet: true` otherwise.

get.description: The OpenAPI description of the public API. No API key needed.

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: The API key, or an OAuth access token starting with pos_

WalletRefusal.description: Something needs wallet credits or a wallet top-up. Open `url` on the Studio app (relative to it, e.g. https://studio.voholabs.com/wallet) to top up.

identifier.description: Provider, e.g. linkedin, x, tiktok, instagram, discord

path.description: Hosted URL; pass it as an image path on a post

inter.description: Repeat the post every n days

settings.description: The channel's settings (GET /integration-settings/{id}). Required unless type is draft.

value.description: The post, then each thread item or comment

content.description: HTML for most channels. "(post:<postId>)" is replaced with that post's live URL when this one publishes.

balance.description: Credits, 2 decimals; can be negative after usage already incurred

payAsYouGo.description: True after the first top-up, while the wallet is not frozen

creditsPerUnit.description: Credits bought with one unit of the currency (e.g. per $1)

charged.description: False when this provider is not charged per post

dueCredits.description: What scheduling takes now; negative gives credits back

short.description: Scheduling it now would be refused with 402

Unauthorized.description: No API key, or an invalid one

PaymentRequired.description: Needs wallet credits or a top-up (`wallet: true`), or a paid plan

StorageFull.description: The free plan's media library is full
